In this video, we explore how when trying maximize and improve ourselves and our spaces, we can inadvertently find ourselves experiencing worse versions. Of course, there's nothing wrong with improving things and ourselves. But self-improvement and modern society has sold us the idea that we must improve ourselves and our systems to extreme levels in order to become the "best versions of ourselves". But the fine print warning on the back is so often over-looked: If we're not careful, these "best versions" of ourselves can also become the most miserable.
